propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTelecommunicationsApplianceTypeMasterUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to MASTERUNIT.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: MaximumNumberOfConnectedRUs
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum number of remote units (RUs) which can be connected to the master unit.

properties.name: TransmissionType
properties.definition: Indicates the data transmission type of the master unit.

properties.name: TransmittedBandwidth
properties.definition: Indicates the transmitted bandwidth of the master unit.

properties.name: TransmittedFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates the transmitted frequency used by the master unit.

properties.name: TransmittedSignal
properties.definition: Indicates the type or standard of signal transmitted by the master unit.
